title: processkit write plan
description: The reviewed plan of a writing command (cli@v1 PK-CLI-012, PK-CLI-031). Entries of 'changes' have the shape of repository-storage@v1 schemas/file-change.schema.json.

operation.description: The command that created the plan.

root.description: Absolute path of the selected repository root.

release.description: processkit release that computed the plan, as in processkit version -o json 'release'.

inputs.description: Every input file and every target path the plan depends on, sorted by path. A null digest means the path did not exist.

changes.description: Repository files the plan will change, sorted by path; shape per repository-storage@v1 file-change.schema.json.

confirmationRequired.description: True when the plan needs confirmation before it is applied (PK-CLI-014, PK-CLI-032).
